phrase: A chatbot app's shared chats turned out to be public, exposing personal secrets. The same week, a music platform pulled fifty million AI tracks it called slop from its recommendations.
phraseAlternatives: A chat app's sharing feature leaked personal and business secrets onto the open web. A music service spent the year pulling fifty million AI tracks it called slop from recommendations.
Thousands of private chatbot conversations turned out to be searchable online. Meanwhile, a streaming platform pulled fifty million tracks it labeled AI slop from its recommendations.
A chatbot's share button exposed private conversations to search engines. A streaming platform, less forgiving, pulled fifty million tracks it called AI slop from its recommendations.
alt: A two-panel riso print divided by a thin vertical line. On the left, a worried robot's cracked SHARE speech bubble sprays note papers up toward a web shape. On the right, a person turns a dial away from a pile of identical music-track icons while a swept dashed arrow carries them down into a bin labeled SLOP.

brief.concept: A chatbot's SHARE button springs a leak like a cracked pipe, spraying private notes across the open web, while nearby a person adjusts a recommendation dial, sweeping a mountain of duplicate music-track icons out of its glow.
brief.metaphor: Sharing as a broken pipe spraying secrets outward; cleanup as a dial turned away from unwanted machine-made clutter.

cast.who: a chatbot speech bubble with a SHARE button, cracked like a leaking pipe
small note-shaped papers spilling from the crack into an open network shape
a person turning a recommendation dial away from a pile of identical round track icons
a bin marked SLOP catching the swept tracks

brief.composition: Two vignettes side by side on one card, separated by a thin divider. Left: a speech bubble with a SHARE arrow cracks and sprays small note papers toward a web/network shape in the background. Right: a person turns a recommendation dial away from a pile of identical round track icons, sweeping some into a bin labeled SLOP. Only text in the image: SHARE and SLOP.
